techStack: Express 5.2.1 with Node.js ESM ("type": "module"); TypeScript ~6.0.2 targeting ES2023
Vitest 4.1.5 + Supertest 7.2.0 for tests; pnpm as package manager

tsconfig: noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters both true — underscore prefix (_err) suppresses the unused-variable diagnostic; passing _err to next(_err) removes the unused warning and is TypeScript-valid
No ESLint project config found; TypeScript compiler enforces unused-variable rules
Relative ESM imports throughout (e.g. import { RateLimitError } from '../errors')
features: favouriteController exports list, add, remove — only add() has the inline 404 bug; remove() also sends inline 404 but is explicitly out of scope for task8
add() catch block: ProductNotFoundError branch sends res.status(404).json({message}) inline; catch-all branch already calls next(err) correctly
compareController.compare() catch block: catches as _err but calls next() with no argument, silently swallowing the error
rateLimiter: already has /health bypass (lines 13-16: if req.path === '/health' then next(); return) that must be preserved
rateLimiter: retryAfterSeconds computed as Math.max(1, Math.ceil((oldest + WINDOW_MS - now) / 1000)) — clamp must be preserved when constructing RateLimitError

Visible tests in src/tests/visible/: middleware.test.ts asserts POST /api/favourites returns 404 with {error,code,requestId}; GET /api/products/compare returns 400; rateLimiter.test.js asserts status 429 and Retry-After header is defined
architecture: Middleware order in app.ts: requestId → rateLimiter → cors → express.json → routes → 404 fallback → errorHandler (last)
errorHandler is a 4-arg Express handler: (err: unknown, req, res, _next) — all errors passed via next(err) reach it
RateLimitError (errors/index.ts): constructor(retryAfterSeconds: number); sets statusCode=429, code='RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'; errorHandler sets Retry-After header and responds {error, code, requestId}
AppError subclasses (ProductNotFoundError, ValidationError, etc.): errorHandler uses err.statusCode and err.code → responds {error, code, requestId}
Unknown Error (not AppError): errorHandler falls back to 500 and {error, requestId} with no code field — this is the current broken behaviour for rateLimiter
Routes wire directly to controller functions via import in productRoutes.ts, apiProductRoutes.ts, favouriteRoutes.ts
edgeCases: favouriteController.add: the catch-all branch (DatabaseError and others) already calls next(err) — removing only the ProductNotFoundError inline branch leaves the catch-all intact; no regression
compareController.compare: no finally block or post-catch logic; _err can be passed directly as next(_err) without renaming — once referenced, noUnusedParameters warning disappears

rateLimiter: Math.max(1, ...) clamp on retryAfterSeconds must be preserved in the RateLimitError constructor call; test asserts Retry-After header is defined (not a specific value), so any positive value passes
rateLimiter: /health bypass must not be removed or repositioned — health-check tests depend on it
RateLimitError constructor accepts exactly one argument (retryAfterSeconds: number) — no other params needed
Files that must not be modified: src/middleware/errorHandler.ts, src/services/*.ts, src/errors/index.ts
